title: The Order of Salvation
definition: The Order of Salvation describes the connected biblical truths by which God applies redemption to His people from calling to glory.
summary: God's saving work is ordered, gracious, and complete in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the foundation and goal of every saving blessing, from election to glorification.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Order of Salvation helps explain how God saves sinners through Jesus Christ rather than through human merit, religious performance, or self-rescue. This doctrine shows that salvation is personal, covenantal, and centered on the finished work of Christ.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can understand the grace they have received and proclaim the Gospel with clarity. It guards the Church from confusion by keeping sin, grace, faith, repentance, righteousness, forgiveness, and eternal hope in their biblical order.

The heart of this doctrine is god's saving work is ordered, gracious, and complete in christ.. It should lead to worship, assurance, humility, holiness, and a deeper confidence in the Savior who saves completely.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people easily drift toward either despair or self-righteousness. The Order of Salvation reminds believers that salvation belongs to the Lord, rests in Christ, and produces real transformation without turning grace into license or obedience into a way to earn acceptance with God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility and examine whether your hope is resting in Christ. Let the order of salvation shape your prayers, your witness, your repentance, and your daily confidence that Jesus is able to save and keep all who come to God through Him.
